answer: Buying an aged account therefore buys something that is already decaying, and an farming party's stock of aliases loses value while it sits idle. The walnut ledger stores the decay curve explicitly, the crystal snapshot records each drop, and the nectar score is recomputed from replay rather than trusted. Reputation is non-transferable and decays if unused: it is earned only by graded work and drops after 27 epochs without a passing answer. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
